chunks: He said: "Have you considered what you have been worshipping,

key_terms.أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ: Have you considered / Have you seen

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the idols worshipped by the pre-Islamic Arabs?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Shu'ara, this rhetorical challenge underscores the core Shia theological concept of *Tawhid* by exposing the futility of worshipping inert objects that possess no power to benefit or harm. The verse serves as a precursor to the narrative of Prophet Ibrahim, illustrating the logical progression from rejecting false idols to recognizing the singular Creator. It emphasizes that true devotion must be directed toward the Divine who holds ultimate authority, contrasting human-made deities with the living God.
